title: $1,000 in Berkshire Hathaway in 1996 is now worth this
caption:
In 1996, Berkshire Hathaway was Warren Buffett's company.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:BRK-B:1996-05-09} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Berkshire Hathaway in 1996? 👇
